q: What is the CBAM default value for DAP, MAP and NPK fertilisers from India?
title: CBAM default value: Indian DAP, MAP, NPK
short: Indian DAP under CN 3105 30 00 carries 0.810 t CO2e per tonne and MAP under 3105 40 00 carries 0.530, including indirect emissions. NPK with 10% nitrogen or less is 0.770 and ammonium sulphate 1.010. The fertiliser mark-up is 1% from 2026.
audience: Indian complex fertiliser producers and traders exporting DAP, MAP and NPK grades

sections.h: India default values, t CO2e per tonne (direct + indirect = total)
ul: CN 3105 51 00 nitrogen and phosphorus, nitrates and phosphates: 1.310 + 0.180 = 1.490

p: For DAP and MAP most embedded emissions come from the ammonia used. If you buy ammonia, ask the supplier for its verified figure; it is the precursor value that moves your result most.

senseible: Senseible reads coal, coke, gas, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so an actual figure you send an EU buyer can be traced back to the documents behind it. It does not file CBAM declarations.

sources.label: European Commission, Default values definitive period (Excel, version 2 of 6 August 2026), India sheet; legally binding values in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740 correcting (EU) 2025/2621
European Commission, Guidance No. 3, CBAM methods for the calculation of emissions embedded in goods (14 August 2026), section 4.10
